findings.evidence: Three real Linux negative controls replace a checked directory with a link immediately before the file syscall. findings.title: Raw runtime document streams lack live access-invalidation cancellation
findings.evidence: Four pre-fix negative controls fail: no required monitor, no cancellation for an admitted content request on account change or monitor loss, and unavailable-monitor admission succeeds. The dispatcher now requires an initialized monitor, catches up before authority, rechecks the runtime generation, cancels the complete captured actor set for content reads, and waits for source/response cleanup before invalidation acknowledgement. A real PostgreSQL/HTTP held-file stream is cancelled after membership removal, preserves only the sent prefix, and holds the applied revision until source cleanup finishes. The scoped dispatcher report is100% statements/branches/functions/lines (the parser-closed assertNever default is explicitly excluded);15 named cases including the actual PostgreSQL flow pass. The regression preserves uploader as creation actor and advances the root checkpoint.30 broker cases and compiled authority/maintenance replay pass; the current407-case Gateway regression passes.

findings.title: A committed receiver prefix remains pending after an interrupted private acknowledgement
findings.evidence: Two pre-fix runs reproduce pending=true after retry with no changes beyond the receiver cursor. The broker validates the receiver position against the retained journal and acknowledges that known prefix before returning or sending newer changes. The broker unit regression and compiled real HTTP maintenance replay inject a local acknowledgement failure after the catalog commits; retry finishes the upload, drains writers, sends one batch total and performs no further cursor reads once acknowledged. No future or unknown positions are accepted.

findings.title: Recreating a project at a retained document path reuses its retired scope identity owner and cannot synchronize ownership

Former HTTP/engine owners drain before replacement. Active files receive new legacy identities with unknown creators; old trash and upload sessions stay private byte archives. Actual replay verifies administrator200, old upload404 even for its original user, old trash/content hidden, raw private data retained in backup and isolation after restore/restart. Corrupt retirement evidence, missing retained metadata and modified archive bytes are rejected. Active legacy stores keep ids only with a nonempty committed catalog prefix. Linux Node22.22.1/24.19.0 real nobody/daemon probes preserve public access and creator while denying other-account/private metadata/actor/object access. Named proactive cache-removal paths are completed under B218; source-leaf review and remaining retained-root/platform cases stay open.

All37 identity filesystem cases pass; the real PostgreSQL download and save transcript also passes.

findings.title: Browser resumable uploads lack live account/project revocation and monitor-loss cancellation

findings.title: A response closed during upload inspection loses cancellation before chunk store admission
findings.evidence: A deterministic pre-fix handler closes its response during asynchronous upload inspection, then successfully stores a chunk with a live signal. Cancellable handlers now initialize their signal from an already-destroyed response as well as future close events. The regression refuses late storage without a response. All31 handler-edge cases pass; all68 Host consumer cases pass, as does the current root8-gate build.

findings.title: Removed document scopes retain their cached identity engine and permit delayed authorization to reopen storage

Unit cases cover personal/project deletion, delayed authorization, already-resolved engine fencing and lookup outage/recovery. Real PostgreSQL/HTTP and plain-Node compiled replays prove engine refusal after removal while active files, prior private trash/upload bytes and backup isolation remain retained. Current13-file407-case regression passes.

findings.title: Gateway waits for writer quiescence before cancelling the Runtime start that holds that writer
